common: Edit the supplied chosen classroom image into the following NEW complete hidden-object scene, preserving its EXACT clean SOFT 2.5D CARTOON art direction: gentle smooth volume, matte pastel surfaces, very light wood texture, warm upper-left sunlight, subtle contact shadows, simple cream walls and floor, honey oak, mint, sky blue, coral, soft yellow. NOT realistic photography, not clay, not thick outlined flat vector. LANDSCAPE 1536x1024. One coherent scene, every object naturally rests on furniture or hangs on a wall, no floating clipart. Minimal decor, large separated readable objects, maximum one small plain potted plant, no busy patterns, no flowers or vines except a simple tiny motif inside a picture. NO people, emoji, words, letters, numerals, UI or answer circles. Critical educational distinction: SQUARE faces are visibly exact 1:1 equal width and height, frontal and aligned to picture plane, not perspective-squashed; RECTANGULAR faces are visibly long 2:1 or tall 1:2, never near-square. All books are clearly LONG rectangular 2:1; do NOT use a book as a square example. Do not add decorative extra books or framed pictures. Exactly the listed 8 principal objects.

scenes.subject: Clean child's bedroom, simple mint bed at left with one yellow cushion, low shelf at far left, plain study desk right. Three SQUARE targets: one large single-pane square window upper-left; one square blue landscape picture frame upper-middle; one genuinely square yellow cushion propped upright face-on on bed middle-left. Five distractors: circular wall clock upper-right; one triangular coral fabric pennant hanging mid-right above desk; pentagonal flower frame on left shelf mid-height; clearly long rectangular green book on low foreground table lower-middle (2:1 cover); circular cream coaster at lower-right table. Quiet uncluttered floor, no rug pattern.

Clean SCHOOL classroom, two chairs and a low central school desk. Three exact 1:1 SQUARE targets: single-pane square window upper-left; perfectly square green chalkboard centered upper wall with no chalk writing; square coral seat cushion propped vertically face-on against left chair back, middle-left. Five distractors: circular wall clock upper-right; long horizontal rectangular blue textbook 2:1 on right desk; triangular yellow set-square ruler near desk middle; pentagonal small picture frame on right shelf; circular cream plate on front-left table corner. No other books, no square notebook.

Clean SCHOOL learning room, one simple low table and plain cream wall, one mint bench right. Clean child's bedroom with mint bed left and oak study desk center.
